title: Kates Test Scenario File v1
description: Declarative scenario file for kates test apply and kates test lint. Holds either a scenarios list or a single scenario at the top level.

scenarios.description: List of test scenarios executed sequentially by kates test apply.

name.description: Human-readable name for a single top-level scenario.

type.description: The benchmark or validation test type to run.

backend.description: Execution engine backend: native (Kates producer/consumer engine) or trogdor.

spec.description: Scenario workload and Kafka client/topic parameters. Uses scenario field names (records, parallelProducers, recordSizeBytes, durationSeconds, targetThroughput).

validate.description: SLA gates checked by kates test apply --wait after the scenario finishes.

scenarioItem.description: A single test scenario with workload parameters and optional SLA validation gates.

name.description: Display name of the scenario shown in progress output and JUnit reports.

type.description: The benchmark or validation test type to run.

backend.description: Execution engine backend: native (default) or trogdor.

spec.description: Scenario workload and Kafka client/topic parameters.

validate.description: SLA gates checked by kates test apply --wait.

records.description: Number of records each producer task sends (1..100,000,000). Note: use 'records' in scenario files, not 'numRecords'.

parallelProducers.description: Number of concurrent producer tasks (1..64). Note: use 'parallelProducers' in scenario files, not 'numProducers'.

recordSizeBytes.description: Payload size of each record in bytes (1..10,485,760). Note: use 'recordSizeBytes' in scenario files, not 'recordSize'.

durationSeconds.description: Maximum test duration in seconds (0 for record-count bounded, or 1..86,400). Converted to durationMs (x1000) when sent to the API.

targetThroughput.description: Target producer rate in records/sec per producer, or -1 for unthrottled maximum throughput. SPIKE and CAPACITY require -1.

topic.description: Kafka topic name (1..249 ASCII alphanumeric, '.', '_', or '-' chars). Auto-generated if omitted.

acks.description: Producer acknowledgment mode: "all" (or "-1"), "1", or "0". Must be "all" or "-1" when enableIdempotence or enableTransactions is true.

compressionType.description: Producer compression codec: none, gzip, snappy, lz4, or zstd.

replicationFactor.description: Topic replication factor (1..10). Must be >= minInsyncReplicas.

consumerGroup.description: Consumer group ID (1..255 printable ASCII chars). Applicable only to LOAD, ENDURANCE, and INTEGRITY tests.

fetchMinBytes.description: Consumer fetch.min.bytes (1..16,777,216). Applicable only to LOAD, ENDURANCE, and INTEGRITY tests.

fetchMaxWaitMs.description: Consumer fetch.max.wait.ms (1..60,000). Applicable only to LOAD, ENDURANCE, and INTEGRITY tests.

enableIdempotence.description: Enable Kafka producer idempotence (enable.idempotence=true). Requires acks: "all".

enableTransactions.description: Enable transactional producer/consumer (EOS). Requires acks: "all", enableIdempotence: true, and backend: native.

enableCrc.description: Enable payload CRC32 verification. Applicable only to INTEGRITY tests.

maxP99LatencyMs.description: Maximum allowed p99 producer latency in milliseconds (> 0; setting 0 turns the gate off).

maxAvgLatencyMs.description: Maximum allowed average producer latency in milliseconds (> 0; setting 0 turns the gate off).

minThroughputRecPerSec.description: Minimum required aggregate producer throughput in records/second (> 0; setting 0 turns the gate off).

maxErrorRate.description: Maximum error rate (0.0..1.0). Note: kates test apply --wait does not check maxErrorRate; use maxDataLossPercent on INTEGRITY runs.

maxDataLossPercent.description: Maximum allowed data loss percentage (0.0..100.0; 0 enforces zero data loss on INTEGRITY runs).

maxRtoMs.description: Maximum allowed Recovery Time Objective (RTO) in milliseconds (> 0).

maxRpoMs.description: Maximum allowed Recovery Point Objective (RPO) in milliseconds (> 0).

maxOutOfOrder.description: Maximum allowed out-of-order message count (>= 0; 0 enforces strict ordering on INTEGRITY runs).

maxCrcFailures.description: Maximum allowed CRC payload mismatch count (>= 0; 0 enforces zero corruption on INTEGRITY runs).

perTask.description: When true, evaluates SLA gates against each individual task row rather than the run aggregate.
